import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static long totalCount;
    static int baseVal;
    static long[][] matrices = new long[30][30];
    static long[][] inv_matrices = new long[30][30];
    static long[][][] E = new long[200][40][30];
    static long[][][] EI = new long[200][40][30];
    static long[] current_vector = new long[30];

    static class V {
        long[] arr = new long[30];
    }

    static class M {
        long[][] mat = new long[30][30];
    }

    static long getVal(long num) {
        if (num < baseVal) return num;
        return (num + getVal(num / baseVal)) % baseVal;
    }

    static M multiply(M a, M b) {
        M res = new M();
        for (int i = 0; i < baseVal; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < baseVal; j++) {
                res.mat[i][j] = 0;
                for (int l = 0; l < baseVal; l++) {
                    res.mat[i][j] += (a.mat[i][l] * b.mat[l][j]) % MOD;
                }
                res.mat[i][j] %= MOD;
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static V multiply(M m, V v) {
        V res = new V();
        for (int i = 0; i < baseVal; i++) {
            res.arr[i] = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < baseVal; j++) {
                res.arr[i] += (v.arr[j] * m.mat[i][j]) % MOD;
            }
            res.arr[i] %= MOD;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void precompute_matrices() {
        for (int i = 0; i < baseVal; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < baseVal; j++) {
                E[0][i][j] = matrices[i][j];
                EI[0][i][j] = inv_matrices[i][j];
            }
        }
        int LOG = 0;
        long t = totalCount;
        while (t > 0) {
            LOG++;
            t /= baseVal;
        }
        for (int j = 1; j <= LOG; j++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < baseVal; i++) {
                for (int l = 0; l < baseVal; l++) {
                    E[j][i][l] = multiply(new M() {{ mat = E[j - 1][l]; }}, new M() {{ mat = E[j - 1][i]; }}).mat;
                    EI[j][i][l] = multiply(new M() {{ mat = EI[j - 1][i][l]; }}, new M() {{ mat = EI[j - 1][l]; }}).mat;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static V solve_vector(long n, V v, int at) {
        if (n == 0) return v;
        int w = (int) getVal(n / baseVal);
        v = solve_vector(n / baseVal, v, at + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < n % baseVal; i++) {
            v = multiply(new M() {{ mat = E[at][(w + i) % baseVal]; }}, v);
        }
        return v;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        totalCount = sc.nextLong();
        baseVal = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < baseVal; i++) {
            current_vector.arr[i] = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < baseVal; j++) {
                for (int l = 0; l < baseVal; l++) {
                    if (j == l) {
                        matrices[i][j] = 1;
                        inv_matrices[i][j] = 1;
                    } else if (j == i) {
                        matrices[i][j] = 1;
                        inv_matrices[i][j] = -1;
                    } else {
                        matrices[i][j] = 0;
                        inv_matrices[i][j] = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        precompute_matrices();
        V v = new V();
        v.arr = current_vector;
        v = solve_vector(totalCount, v, 0);
        long total_sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < baseVal; i++) {
            total_sum += v.arr[i];
        }
        total_sum--;
        total_sum %= MOD;
        if (total_sum < 0) total_sum += MOD;
        while (total_sum % (baseVal - 1) != 0) {
            total_sum += MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(total_sum / (baseVal - 1));
        sc.close();
    }
}
